x: Our performances in the last few winters have been solid and we have established ourselves as a "top half of the league" team, but if we want to win it we are going to have to come out with all guns blazing in race one. R.Collier, K.Taylor and P.Doorgachurn also ran but positions unknown.
Well done to all who took part – Barnaby and Toby Hodgeson, Terry Tsai, Hugo Sells, Roy Collier and Phillip Doorgachurn. As a team they placed 8th of the 14 clubs who took part with 317 points.
No club had a full five in the under 13 contest where Belgrave numbered four boys who excelled in gaining second, top scorer being Philip Doorgachurn.
